scenario: LCST.4.6.1 — the coercion call form Json(binding) is refused. Pin: Json(a) in a call kwarg rejects with DS_VALIDATE_COERCION_FORM_REMOVED, guiding the author to a::Json (the fact->Json cast).
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

service ext.api:
    kwarg body: Json
    no response

rule r:
    Event a
->
    call ext.api body: Json(a) nocooldown
